setup: const { ColossusLab } = await import('/src/dev/colossus_lab.js'); const lab = new ColossusLab(g); window.__lab = lab; lab.cutWorld(-600, -50, -900, 600, 200, -186); const b = await lab.build('masa'); lab.place(b, 2, 0, -47, 0); lab.atmo('fire', { density: 0.0085, far: 260 }); window.__colTick = (dt) => lab.tick(dt); g.player.spawn(0.5, 0, -8, 3.14); return { ms: b.ms, sculpt: b.model.sculptStats, stats: b.model.stats() };
